Moonshine voice transcription stays on this phone. MOSS Live is different: when you explicitly start it, microphone audio is streamed through your computer to MOSS. Camera sharing is not available in this build. Normal live AI sends only the question, recent conversation and any attached photo; relevant book passages may also be sent.
Recent chats share about 100 MB. Older unsaved messages and photos are removed when space is needed. Saved chats remain until you delete them, uninstall the app, or clear its data.

Readable PDF text is kept as is. Pages needing OCR are processed on this phone. The selected PDF and recognized text are sent over the local USB connection and stored in the private book library on this computer. No OCR cloud service is used.

Connects to your local computer running MOSS Live and the assistant backend. Default is 127.0.0.1:8000 (via USB cable). For wireless use without a cable, enter your computer\'s Wi-Fi IP address and port (e.g. 172.30.43.18:8000).
